# Monthly S&OP Executive Briefing: March 2026 (M4)

**To:** Executive Leadership Team  
**From:** Supply Chain Analyst  
**Date:** April 2026  
**Subject:** Monthly Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) Update & Reorder Recommendations

## Executive Summary

US market demand across Shopify and Amazon continues strong, double-digit growth (+25.1% overall unit growth from M1 to M4). Total monthly unit sales rose from **5,740 units ($234k)** in December (M1) to **7,180 units ($338k)** in March (M4). 

However, **our replenishment pipeline has stalled for key SKUs**. While our core 250g jars are well-stocked, **all three 500g core Manuka SKUs, two Bioactive Blends, and Propolis Tincture have ZERO units on order** and will face stockouts within 30 to 60 days if POs are not issued immediately.

## 1. March 2026 (M4) Sales Performance

### High Performers (Top Revenue & Volume Drivers)
* **Manuka Honey MGO 263+ 250g**: Our #1 volume and revenue driver. Sold **1,604 units** in M4 generating **$56,124** in revenue (+20.8% volume increase vs. M1).
* **Manuka Honey MGO 514+ 250g**: Our #2 revenue driver. Sold **940 units** in M4 generating **$46,991** (+23.7% volume increase vs. M1).
* **Manuka Honey MGO 263+ 500g**: Strong high-ticket performer. Sold **684 units** generating **$37,613** (+23.0% volume increase vs. M1).

## 4. Priority Reorder Recommendations

Ranked strictly by **Projected Monthly Revenue Opportunity** ($\text{Retail Price} \times \text{Projected M5 Demand}$, assuming recent monthly growth trends continue into M5):

### #1 Reorder Recommendation: Manuka Honey MGO 263+ 500g
* **Retail Price**: $54.99
* **Projected M5 Demand**: ~732 units (+7% MoM trend)
* **Monthly Revenue Opportunity**: **$40,252.68**
* **Current Stock Cover**: 2.49 Months (1,700 SOH / 0 On Order)
* **Recommended PO Quantity**: **2,000 units**
* **Business Rationale**: This is our single highest revenue-generating SKU without an active purchase order. Because On Order is 0, stock cover will drop to ~1.4 months by the end of next month. With zero inbound stock, we risk stocking out during peak M6 sales. 

### #2 Reorder Recommendation: Manuka Honey MGO 514+ 500g
* **Retail Price**: $79.99
* **Projected M5 Demand**: ~428 units (+9% MoM trend)
* **Monthly Revenue Opportunity**: **$34,235.72**
* **Current Stock Cover**: 1.99 Months (780 SOH / 0 On Order)
* **Recommended PO Quantity**: **1,200 units**
* **Business Rationale**: High price point makes this our second-largest revenue at-risk item. Inventory is already below our 2-month target (1.99 months). Placing an immediate order ensures stock arrives before full depletion in late M5 / early M6.

### #3 Reorder Recommendation: Manuka Honey MGO 850+ 500g
* **Retail Price**: $109.99
* **Projected M5 Demand**: ~268 units (+10% MoM trend)
* **Monthly Revenue Opportunity**: **$29,477.32**
* **Current Stock Cover**: 1.80 Months (440 SOH / 0 On Order)

* **Business Rationale**: Our highest-margin standard format. Stock cover has dropped to 1.80 months. Due to production/testing lead times for high-MGO honey, delaying this order will cause stockouts that directly damage top-line gross margin.
